items.title: U.S. Senate passes stopgap spending bill without Trump priorities
items.summary: Investing.com -- The U.S. Senate approved a short-term spending bill intended to prevent a government shutdown before November’s midterm elections, leaving out President Donald Trump’s requests for Iran war funding and new voter identification measures, Bloomberg reported.

items.title: U.S. plans $1 billion security aid package for Colombia
items.summary: Investing.com -- The Trump administration plans to provide $1 billion in security assistance to the government of Colombia’s newly inaugurated President Abelardo De La Espriella, Reuters reported on Friday, citing the U.S. State Department.

items.title: Rocket Lab Stock Buys You A Different Risk, Not Less Of It
items.summary: Its correlation to the index is only moderate, and the behavior that is genuinely its own runs on defense programs and a rocket that has yet to fly.

items.title: GE Aerospace Talks Less About The Shortage It Still Has
items.summary: The constraint management once pointed to for a fall in shop visit volume now sits inside the growth case, and the raised guidance now rests on working through it.

items.title: Kratos Defense Q2 Earnings and Revenues Outpace Estimates
items.summary: KTOS delivers sharp Q2 earnings and revenue growth as government solutions, organic gains and strong bookings support performance.

items.title: Lockheed Martin is Down 8% in 6 Months: Wall Street Pro Expects 30% Growth Within a Year
items.summary: Lockheed Martin just delivered a blowout quarter with a record-breaking backlog, yet the stock sits near a six-month low while one Wall Street analyst sees nearly 30% upside. The real question is whether a single ugly quarter buried a defense giant or exposed something deeper.

items.title: Boeing's Finished Flight Test Counts Most For A Different Jet
items.summary: Monday's approval was already telegraphed, the rare double upgrade beside it was not, and the finished flight test frees engineering capacity for a different program entirely.

items.title: Lockheed, Northrop Team Up To Rebuild Weapon Stockpile
items.summary: The DOD tapped Lockheed Martin, Northrop Grumman to accelerate Patriot, THAAD production. Anduril looks to build unmanned boats.
